description: 蘇澳商港歷年海氣象觀測月統計資料 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部運輸研究所. 提供蘇澳商港長期風、波及流場實測數據逐月分析。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部運輸研究所. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
